newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REAL SIGN PANUCCI FROM AC MILAN, SAYS SPANISH TV.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REAL SIGN PANUCCI FROM AC MILAN, SAYS SPANISH TV.

text.p: Real Madrid signed defender Christian Panucci from AC Milan on Thursday in a deal believed to be worth 600 million pesetas ($4.6 million), according to Spanish television news reports.
No-one was available to comment at the Madrid club.

Former AC Milan coach Fabio Capello, now in charge at the Bernabeu stadium, has turned to Panucci after problems beset negotiations with Brazilian side Portuguesa for the transfer of right-sided full back Ze Roberto.
